item_name: Rothco Rapid Trek Hydration Pack - Black
item_short_desc: Stay prepared and well equipped with Rothco’s Rapid Trek Hydration Pack. This hydration pack offers essential features for outdoor enthusiasts and active-duty personnel. With a 3-liter bladder and MOLLE compatibility, stay hydrated while on-the-go. The neoprene-covered hose includes a bite valve with an on-off switch for easy drinking, while the quick-release shoulder straps and sternum strap provide a secure fit. The outdoor pack features a top carry handle for convenience and a zipper-close bladder compartment for easy access.
description: Stay prepared and well equipped with Rothco’s Rapid Trek Hydration Pack. This hydration pack offers essential features for outdoor enthusiasts and active-duty personnel. With a 3-liter bladder and MOLLE compatibility, stay hydrated while on-the-go. The neoprene-covered hose includes a bite valve with an on-off switch for easy drinking, while the quick-release shoulder straps and sternum strap provide a secure fit. The outdoor pack features a top carry handle for convenience and a zipper-close bladder compartment for easy access. The front storage compartment with zipper closure offers additional space for essentials. Additionally, the 2 bottom d-rings offer extra gear attachment while the loop field allows you to attach name tape or badge for added versatility.
